coverage.name: Crested Butte (town)
limitations: OWNER REVIEW (tax on residential parcels that are not a primary residence and on vacant land; revenue dedicated to the capital fund, with no housing earmark in the text; no entry created): Town of Crested Butte Ballot Question 2B. Exact text (bullet glyphs omitted): "SHALL THE TOWN OF CRESTED BUTTE TAXES BE INCREASED $1,250,000 IN THE FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR (2027) AND BY WHATEVER AMOUNTS ARE RAISED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER THROUGH THE IMPOSITION OF AN EXCISE TAX ON RESIDENTIAL PARCELS IN TOWN THAT ARE NOT A PRIMARY RESIDENCE AND ON VACANT LAND AS FOLLOWS: TOTAL RESIDENTIAL SQUARE FOOTAGE ON THE PARCEL OF LESS THAN 1,200 SQUARE FEET $1,400 TOTAL RESIDENTIAL SQUARE FOOTAGE ON THE PARCEL THAT IS EQUAL TO OR MORE THAN 1,200 AND UP TO 2,200 SQUARE FEET $2,400 TOTAL RESIDENTIAL SQUARE FOOTAGE ON THE PARCEL EQUAL TO OR MORE THAN 2,200 SQUARE FEET $3,400 VACANT LAND $3,000 WITH SUCH TAX AMOUNTS TO INCREASE ANNUALLY BY THE PERCENTAGE RATE OF INFLATION AS DEFINED IN ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE STATE CONSTITUTION FOR THE PRECEDING CALENDAR YEAR; AND SHALL ALL REVENUES FROM SUCH TAX BE DEPOSITED IN AND DEDICATED TO THE CAPITAL FUND, SUCH TAX TO BE COLLECTED AND SPENT AS A VOTER APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE NOTWITHSTANDING ANY REVENUE OR EXPENDITURE LIMITATIONS CONTAINED IN ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION?"
The referring resolution was not located on the town website; the town elections page has no 2026 ballot content.
No TABOR notice and no list of participating political subdivisions was posted as of 2026-09-26.

measure.official_title: Town of Mt. Crested Butte Ballot Question 2A

fiscal.mechanism: AN INCREASE OF 5% IN THE TOWN'S EXISTING 4.9% SHORT TERM RENTAL EXCISE TAX
fiscal.rate: FOR A TOTAL TAX OF 9.9% ON THE AMOUNT CHARGED TO PERSONS RENTING SHORT TERM RENTAL PROPERTIES (DEFINED AS RENTALS FOR LESS THAN 30 DAYS)

entries.neutral_title: Short-term rental excise tax increase for community housing
entries.detail: Raises the town short-term rental excise tax on residential short-term rentals by 5%, from 4.9% to 9.9%, with revenue of not more than $2,500,000 commencing January 1, 2027, for the creation and retention of community housing.

evidence.section: Gunnison County official sample ballot, precinct PCT-004, Town of Mt. Crested Butte Ballot Question 2A
evidence.quote: SHALL TOWN OF MT. CRESTED BUTTE TAXES BE INCREASED NOT MORE THAN $2,500,000 COMMENCING JANUARY 1, 2027 AND BY WHATEVER AMOUNTS ARE GENERATED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY AN INCREASE OF 5% IN THE TOWN'S EXISTING 4.9% SHORT TERM RENTAL EXCISE TAX, FOR A TOTAL TAX OF 9.9% ON THE AMOUNT CHARGED TO PERSONS RENTING SHORT TERM RENTAL PROPERTIES (DEFINED AS RENTALS FOR LESS THAN 30 DAYS), SUCH INCREASE TO APPLY ONLY TO SHORT TERM RENTAL PROPERTIES WHICH ARE CLASSIFIED BY THE GUNNISON COUNTY ASSESSOR AS "RESIDENTIAL", FOR THE PURPOSE OF RAISING FUNDS TO SUPPORT THE CREATION AND RETENTION OF CRITICAL COMMUNITY HOUSING, AND SHALL ALL AMOUNTS RECEIVED BY THE TOWN FROM SUCH TAX AND OTHER REVENUES AND EARNINGS THEREON BE COLLECTED AND SPENT FOR SUCH PURPOSES WITHOUT LIMITATION OR CONDITION AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION?
